browser.binding: Controller -> model -> worker-api commandId/parameter -> bound model method. Worker cache stores ECU and intermediate apiArgs fields. Promise then/catch/finally and async await bind results; no independent workflow bytecode variables.
browser.callbacks: Known-command onMessageFunction preserves requestId/commandId and posts success or normalized error. Unknown-command branch only binds SendToBrowser without invoking it, sending no response. Utility controller attaches menu/DTC/logout callbacks to loaded controller. Native-dialog in-progress flag vetoes dispose; browser dispose delegates to current workflow.
browser.raw_response_contract: GtsPFApi preserves acknowledgement response Promise when present; normal wrappers return translated response. SendMessageForUtility validates echo fields for implemented SID families21/30/3B/11/19/22/2E/2F/31/3E/01; A6/default no extra echo check. Rejected PF payload maps missing/empty body, negative7F with detail22/31/21/24/35, positive-SID mismatch, other response into typed rejection.
browser.simple_utility: Toyota DDB simple-operation catalog/result DV000059/060 supports status/start/stop and deadline polling; it is separate from arbitrary compiled cassette or JS workflow control flow.
browser.source_loading: UtilityController.getControllerId maps utility ID; unmapped simple-ID range selects SimpleOperationUtility. getUtilityController fetches main scripts, executes via temporary script element, discovers constructor from new window keys; workers importScripts via WorkerController.loadModel, initialize newly registered models then merge command handlers. Cached controller still requests worker load.

utility_execution.cancellation: ComUtilityAbort bytes33C0C20400 return0 with no side effects. Explicit SC14 is communication teardown; JS cancellation flags are workflow-owned and must drive explicit continuation/cleanup. UtilityGene protocol send checks its own abort global after receive; no claim that managed cancel reaches it through the no-op abort export.

examples.branch: NRC21 busy-repeat or24 sequence-error loops; 16-byte failure response byte5=3 binds six status bytes into failure-code list; malformed/other response yields communication error.
examples.cancel: Cancel-click callback sets isCancelClicked; confirmation YES sets isAborted then clears isCancelClicked. Poll checks isAborted before each query and waits100ms while cancel dialog unresolved. Aborted worker skips local cleanup and rejects ABORTED; controller catch calls transitDefaultSession, which attempts mode1 and SC14 regardless of their errors, then returns menu.
examples.errors: Failure to start session attempts SC14 before rejection. Nonaborted poll failure attempts mode1 and SC14 before waiting for dialog resolution and rejecting. Next callback launches but does not return its Promise chain. Native ComUtilityAbort is not this cancellation mechanism.
examples.normal: startGeneralComm SC13 -> optional negative policy UG7 (failure ignored) -> default session UG4 mode1 -> extended mode3. Calibration polling sends RID1103 result query via UG15 after200ms; response length>=6 byte5=2 succeeds; session mode1 then SC14 cleanup precedes result publication.
examples.route: JP/NA ABG_03 -> Abg03 controller/model -> abg_03.* bound worker handlers

examples.branch: Legacy fetch DTC list binds apiArgs.dtcList; nonempty returns isSelectFunction for user DTC/enter choice. Phase5/6 bypass that branch. Confirm level0 transitions, level1 skips transition; unsupported level fails.
examples.result: Host method resolves {isError,isSelectFunction}; controller chooses complete/select/error dialog. Exit callback routes to utility menu; view/event-dispatch disposal is explicit.
examples.waits: Legacy confirms immediately then at1000ms intervals until level1 or eighth failed confirmation; timer cleared on resolution/error/exhaustion. Phase5/6 confirms once after1000ms unless already level1 or returned changeMode1.

utility_execution.execution_model: No common text instruction grammar in these owners: compiled MFC cassette EntranceDLL dispatch for DV61/80; authenticated JavaScript modules and Promise/event continuations for browser workflows; SC13/14 and UG are native communication primitives.

managed_cassette.binding: Nullable integer fields use EbSetPara numeric IDs; nonnull strings use EbSetString UTF16 byte count including terminator; SConfig and UtilityIDHelpInfo serialize into CoTaskMem blocks passed to EbSetData. Body-pinned setter IL carries every implemented field/ID and failure exit.
managed_cassette.broker: Decrypt GTSPlusSetting.ini; OEM cassette-folder and CassetteLibraryName selection; LoadLibrary then resolve EbStart/EbEnd/EbOpenPara/EbWritePara/EbSetPara/EbSetString/EbSetData.
managed_cassette.completion: EbOpenPara -> setters -> EbWritePara -> EbStart synchronous -> EbEnd; each false result produces AppCtrl -1/FFFF code30 or setter31. Finally FreeLibrary then frees SConfig/HelpInfo/SystemName buffers. An earlier failure does not synthesize EbEnd. ExecuteUtility packages broker result into response while outer result commonly remains success.
managed_cassette.continuation: Native broker selects compiled cassette by FunctionID ranges, loads EntranceDLL, invokes synchronously. Selected49 IDs inspect key0x352 dword list: absent/zero ends; nonzero installs next FunctionID, adjusts Toyota continuation data, writes parameters, frees current DLL and selects/loads again.
